import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
import lightgbm as lgb
import warnings
import os

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

print("Loading data...")
train = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
print(f"Train: {train.shape}, Test: {test.shape}")

print("Preparing Tfidf features...")
vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=15000, ngram_range=(1, 1), max_df=0.85, min_df=2
)
X_train = vectorizer.fit_transform(train["comment_text"].fillna(""))
X_test = vectorizer.transform(test["comment_text"].fillna(""))

target_cols = ["toxic", "severe_toxic", "obscene", "threat", "insult", "identity_hate"]

print("Splitting training data...")
train_idx, val_idx = train_test_split(
    range(len(train)),
    test_size=0.2,
    random_state=42,
    stratify=np.zeros(len(train), dtype=int),
)

X_tr, X_val = X_train[train_idx], X_train[val_idx]
y_tr = train.iloc[train_idx][target_cols]
y_val = train.iloc[val_idx][target_cols]

print("Training models...")
models = {}
for col in target_cols:
    model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(
        n_estimators=40,
        learning_rate=0.08,
        max_depth=3,
        num_leaves=20,
        min_child_samples=50,
        random_state=42,
        verbose=-1,
    )
    model.fit(X_tr, y_tr[col])
    models[col] = model
    print(f"  {col} done")

print("\nEvaluating on validation set...")
auc_scores = {}
for col in target_cols:
    pred_prob = models[col].predict(X_val)
    auc = roc_auc_score(y_val[col], pred_prob)
    auc_scores[col] = auc
    print(f"  {col}: {auc:.6f}")

mean_auc = np.mean(list(auc_scores.values()))
print(f"\nMean column-wise ROC AUC: {mean_auc:.6f}")

print("\nGenerating submission...")
test_pred = {}
for col in target_cols:
    test_pred[col] = models[col].predict(X_test)

submission = pd.DataFrame({"id": test["id"], **test_pred})
submission = submission.round(5)

os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Saved submission to ./submission/submission.csv")
